name: omp-codex-lb-responses
description: OMP plugin: a clean codex-lb provider that routes the OpenAI Responses API over codex-lb's WebSocket transport — no source patcher, no global monkeypatch, no synthetic JWT.

omp.name: Codex LB Responses
omp.description: Runs a local HTTP→WebSocket bridge so a `codex-lb` model declared in ~/.omp/agent/models.yml streams over codex-lb's WebSocket (and resolves as the startup default). Configure with `omp plugin config set omp-codex-lb-responses baseUrl <your codex-lb /v1 endpoint>` and `… apiKey <sk-clb-…>` (or the CODEX_LB_* env vars); toggle with `… mode codex-lb|off`.

mode.description: 'codex-lb' (default): run the local HTTP→WS bridge so codex-lb/* works and resolves at startup. 'off': do nothing (use native models). Restart omp after changing.

bridgePort.description: Local port the HTTP→WS bridge listens on (127.0.0.1). Must match the baseUrl port in your models.yml codex-lb declaration. Default 8787.

baseUrl.description: Your codex-lb /v1 endpoint. The plugin opens wss://…/responses derived from it.

apiKey.description: codex-lb API key (sk-clb-…), sent as a plain Authorization: Bearer.

providerId.description: Provider id shown in the model picker (<id>/<model>).

models.description: Comma-separated model ids to register instead of the built-in catalog.

webSearch.description: Web search via codex-lb: 'card' = a native-identical codex web_search (overrides omp's built-in web_search for codex-lb turns; full Search card + sources); 'inject' = hosted web_search tool injected per turn (no card). Default off.

searchModel.description: Model used for `webSearch: card` search requests (defaults to your first model, e.g. gpt-5.5).
